ITEM 1 | Rectangular pastry-wrapped piece, golden-brown crust with a bubbly, slightly blistered surface, about 6 x 4 cm and roughly 2 cm tall; top partly covered by melted white cheese with red pepper pieces and small green herb flecks, glossy with some oil sheen | 85
ITEM 2 | Cluster of breaded or crumbed pieces, golden-tan coating with a grainy, crumbly texture, about 4 to 5 cm across in total, 1.5 to 2 cm thick; mixed with small red pepper bits and a green herb leaf tucked among them, slightly dry matte surface | 70
ITEM 3 | Mixed green salad heap, pale frilly greenish-white frisée leaves with darker green lettuce leaves, about 8 x 6 cm footprint and 3 cm tall, crisp and dry-looking, with a few small yellow kernels and a dark olive lying at its base | 35
ITEM 4 | Small chunk of fresh-looking red tomato or pepper, glossy red, about 2 x 1.5 cm, sitting at the base of the salad | 8
ITEM 5 | Thin smear of pale cream-colored sauce or dressing, about 8 cm long and under 0.5 cm thick, lightly glossy, pooled near the pastry and across the plate edge | 5
